title: TLS verification disabled in the Yarn configuration
description: .yarnrc declares a `.yarnrc` `enableStrictSsl` switch set to false. A verification or locking control is switched off, so the integrity guarantees the ecosystem offers are not applied here. This rule reads a `.yarnrc` `enableStrictSsl` switch set to false.
remediation: Turn the control back on and fix what it reported instead of disabling the check. Specifically: fix a `.yarnrc` `enableStrictSsl` switch set to false.
limitation: It matches a `.yarnrc` `enableStrictSsl` switch set to false in the parsed .yarnrc; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
